JOOL SUITES.note: Jool Suites is a freehold 52-unit apartment (completed 2014, developer SJ Capital) about a 4-minute walk from Farrer Park MRT in the Jalan Besar/Little India area. Recent resale transactions have averaged roughly S$1,780-1,790 psf.

SELETAR PARK RESIDENCE.note: Seletar Park Residence is a 276-unit 99-year leasehold condo (TOP 2015) by Asplenium Land, sited next to the Greenwich V retail podium off Yio Chu Kang/Seletar Road in D28. Recent transactions have averaged around S$1,240-1,250 psf.

ICON.note: Icon is a 646-unit 99-year leasehold development (completed 2007) at 10 Gopeng Street in Tanjong Pagar, set to benefit from new Circle Line Stage 6 stations (Keppel, Cantonment, Prince Edward Road) opening 12 July 2026 and the long-term Greater Southern Waterfront transformation as the port relocates to Tuas. No active en bloc has been reported.

ALEXIS.note: Alexis is a freehold mixed development of 293 residential units plus 18 shops at 356 Alexandra Road (completed 2012, developer EC Prime), close to Redhill MRT in D03. Nearby new supply in the Queenstown/Margaret Drive area includes recent 2025 launches such as Margaret Drive Residences.

THE BERTH BY THE COVE.note: The Berth by the Cove is a 200-unit 99-year leasehold condo by Ho Bee Land (completed 2006), the first project in Sentosa Cove and the first Singapore waterfront development with private boat berths. Sentosa Cove (D04) has been pressured by the 60% foreigner ABSD, with foreign buyers' share of D04 falling from 11.3% in 2023 to 4.3% in 2024 and about 66% of 2025 resales loss-making.

ONE-NORTH RESIDENCES.note: The 99-year leasehold development by UOL/Kheng Leong (with Low Keng Huat) sits within JTC's one-north business park and is served by both one-north (CC23) and Buona Vista (CC22/EW21) MRT interchange stations. Nearby new supply is expanding, with One-North Eden (TOP 2023) and the upcoming Media Circle GLS condo adding units to the precinct.

THE COAST AT SENTOSA COVE.note: The 249-unit, 99-year leasehold Sentosa Cove waterfront condo by Ho Bee Land (completed 2010) has seen average PSF decline about 10% from 2023 to 2026 (roughly S$1,682 to S$1,510) amid thin resale volume but active leasing. EdgeProp records a majority of profitable transactions over the project's history.

GUILLEMARD EDGE.note: The 275-unit freehold development (38 Lorong 30 Geylang) by Macly Equity is within walking distance of Dakota MRT, where the same developer's freehold NoMa (completed 2024) adds nearby boutique supply. The larger 1,008-unit Grand Dunman mega project (SingHaiyi) is a major new supply source in the area, targeted to TOP around 2027.

THE WOODGROVE.note: The Woodgrove is a 72-unit development in Woodlands (D25) with no reported en-bloc activity. The area stands to benefit from the Johor Bahru-Singapore RTS Link at Woodlands North (Thomson-East Coast Line), which is targeted to open by December 2026.

LINCOLN SUITES.note: Lincoln Suites is a 175-unit freehold condo at 1 Khiang Guan Avenue in Newton (D11), completed in 2014, a short walk from Newton MRT interchange. Resale activity over the past year has been modest but mostly profitable, with 12-month prices averaging roughly S$2,000-2,100 psf.
